Visit note | 2025-07-16 10:30 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Habiba Faruque, 51, female. Mrs. Faruque returns for review of her recurring headaches. She describes a throbbing headache on one side of her head accompanied by nausea and a strong need to lie down in a dark room. She is a bank officer and mentions her symptoms have been worse since she began working with bright screens at a new job in Sirajganj. She reports about 4 headache days a month. She has no other significant medical conditions and denies weakness, visual loss, or fever. On examination: BP 127/76 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, weight 57 kg, and neurological examination is normal. Assessment: Migraine. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up in 3 months with the headache diary.

Visit note | 2025-07-16 11:00 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Rashid Hossain, 44, male.
